description.value:
Frequency 1/round

Spend your action lining up instead of firing. Your next Strike against that Mark before the start of your next turn deals full precision damage — an extra 2d8 (3d8 at Veteran, 4d8 at Undying) — whether or not it crits.

cinderfall.incomplete: Otherwise a clean DamageDice pattern (P4-style), fully blocked on the Mark predicate. The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect.
